verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips or tracking devices. Health authorities like the CDC and vaccine manufacturers confirm that vaccines are designed to stimulate an immune response, not to track individuals.
verdicts.reasoning_en: An overwhelming consensus of evidence from TIER_1 health authorities (CDC), fact-checkers (AFP), and vaccine manufacturers (Pfizer) explicitly and repeatedly states that COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips or any form of tracking technology. The claim is a widely debunked conspiracy theory that may have originated from misinterpretations of discussions about digital vaccine records or inventory tracking labels on vials. There is no evidence to support the claim.
